targets.authors: Netemeyer, R.G., Warmath, D., Fernandes, D., & Lynch, J.G., Jr.
targets.title: How am I doing? Perceived financial well-being, its potential antecedents, and its relation to overall well being.
targets.evidence_quote:
The claim selected for replication from Netemeyer et al. (2018) is that in Experiment 3a, there
was an interaction between the valence frame (success vs. failure) and the response scale (lack of
current money management stress vs. expected future financial security), which reflects the
following from the paper’s abstract: "We conceptualize perceived financial well-being as two
related but separate constructs: 1) stress related to the management of money today...and 2) a
sense of security in one’s financial future".
targets.outcome_quote:
The claim selected for the original study yielded an ⍵​2​ = 0.059 in the focal test. The
replication yielded an ⍵​2​ = 0.045 corresponding to a similar pattern compared to the original
study. One of the claims from the original did not replicate due to the lack of a significant
interaction.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The focal comparison replicated, but the authors explicitly state that the original interaction did not replicate; the focal confirmation is not an overall verdict.
